metadata.description: FS-X-CLAUDE: FirstSelfie's Claude Code marketplace for cinematic CGI/VFX, motion design and video skills.

plugins.name: vfx-intro
plugins.description: Cinema-grade 3D/VFX intros from a reference video, an idea or keywords: reverse-engineer, plan, Blender build, graded tests, render, After Effects finish, audit, 1080p/4K export, relinked package.

plugins.name: cinematic-sound
plugins.description: Hollywood / Think School sound for a finished picture: reference analysis, an original score composed to the beat grid with real instruments, physics-true SFX, mix and master, earshot QA.

plugins.name: fs-vox-charts
plugins.description: FirstSelfie Vox-style editorial data-chart animations in After Effects, scripted and rendered headless at 4K.

plugins.name: fs-color-grade
plugins.description: Natural, pro colour grading that recreates a reference's look on your footage (Premiere Lumetri via MCP, Resolve or ffmpeg), keeps brand colours, renders 4K right, and bakes the whole grade into a one-click .cube LUT for editors.
